notes: Big entrance: big_entrance_door origin (part=0) at [12,1,32], facing=south; 3x3 opening x=11..13, y=1..3 in the facade wall plane z=32; outside is z=33.

OPEN sign: the only baked fnafmw:open_neon_sign was at [12,4,32], i.e. embedded in the facade wall (it had replaced a wall block, and the exit sign at [12,4,31] was mounted on its back). That position is now replaced with fnafmw:tan_facade_bricks, matching the surrounding facade, so the wall block is back behind the new sign.

OPEN sign facing is 'north', not 'south'. The mod's model/board sits on the side named by facing (shape wallShapes(0,0,0.93625,1,1,1.06125) = south edge for facing=south; model plane at z=15.98), and the readable 'OPEN' texture is on the opposite face (north face UV [0,0,8,8] is the unmirrored half, south face UV [8,0,16,8] is the mirrored half). So facing=north puts the board flush on the north wall at z=32 and reads outward to the south, the same convention used by the fnaf2/fredbears signfix structures.

OPEN sign height: the canonical outboard cell for a 3-tall door, [12,4,33], is occupied by the projecting cornice fnafmw:caramel_facade_wall_slab(type=top). The nearest valid wall cell above it is [12,5,33] (air, with fnafmw:tan_facade_bricks directly behind at [12,5,32]), so the sign is centered one row higher instead of cutting a notch out of the awning.

Hazard signs audited, no change: [12,2,12] facing=east (wall at x=13), [23,2,2] facing=north (wall at z=1), [30,2,31] facing=south (wall at z=32). Each has its supporting wall on its facing side, which is the mod's mounting convention, so all three are correctly mounted and readable from the room.
exit_sign [12,4,31] rotation=0/wall=true is the south-wall mount and was already correct; it is now backed by the restored tan_facade_bricks at [12,4,32].
